story.title: U2 Sets North American Stops On 2027 Stadium Tour; 2 LA Shows Planned
story.summary: U2 will kick off the North American leg of its 2027 world tour in August in Miami, with the stadium tour then moving throughout the U.S. and Canada. U2 will kick off the North American leg of its “ Carnaval De Luz Presents: The Greatest Show on Earth World Tour 2027″ this August in Miami, the group announced. The 15-stadium tour, with stops in the U.S. and Canada and featuring support acts Stephen Wilson Jr. and the War on Drugs, is currently set to continue through October 18. Among the cities on the tour, in addition to Miami: Atlanta, East Rutherford, Toronto, and two shows in Los Angeles.
